versions.changelog:
huawei-cloud-flexus-l-server-openclaw-deployment v1.0.2

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md with refined instructions and details.
- Minor script changes in channels.py, lib.py, and models.py for improvements or fixes.
- Removed the unused file skill-card.md.
- No significant new features or breaking changes introduced.

- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-flexus-l-server-openclaw-deployment skill.
- Enables automated creation of Huawei Cloud Flexus L (Lightweight Server) instances and deployment of the OpenClaw AI Agent platform.
- Supports model and multi-channel (WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, QQ) installation and configuration for OpenClaw.
- Includes strict security execution rules for handling AK/SK/Token credentials.
- Provides both interactive and non-interactive deployment commands, with support for long-term and temporary credentials via environment variables or input.
- Web UI access for OpenClaw requires manual enablement through the Huawei Cloud console.
